title: BlauOS declarative server configuration
description: Versioned declarative description of a BlauOS server: hostname, accounts with Ed25519 SSH keys (consistent with docs/accounts.md), services within the verified launchd subset (runtime/service-subset.json), network interfaces, data volumes, image version, and fleet metadata. Validated offline by scripts/provisioning/validate_config.py.
$comment: OPEN: boot-time application of a validated configuration inside the guest, idempotent re-application with preserved data, and migrations are not implemented. Gate dependencies #59 and #60 are unresolved; a passing validation is a syntax/semantics check only and is not guest acceptance or physical-hardware evidence. Secrets never appear inline; only opaque references (vault://, file://, keychain://) are permitted and are resolved by a future secret provider.

schema_version.description: Configuration format version. Only version 1 exists; unknown versions are rejected rather than silently interpreted.

hostname.description: RFC 1123 DNS hostname (one or more labels).

image.description: Pinned OS image the configuration applies to.

accounts.description: Named non-root login accounts; mirrors the constraints of docs/accounts.md and scripts/vm/accounts.py (own primary group, public-key-only auth, no wheel membership, no key rotation by overwrite).

ssh_authorized_keys.description: 1-16 bare ssh-ed25519 public keys (no authorized_keys options, no private keys, no comments).

services.description: launchd jobs restricted to the verified subset in runtime/service-subset.json: RunAtLoad, KeepAlive, MachServices. GUI sessions, sandbox profiles, and arbitrary XPC compatibility are excluded and cannot be expressed.

address.description: IPv4 address; required for static, forbidden for dhcp.

gateway.description: IPv4 default gateway for static mode.

volumes.description: Data volumes mounted in addition to the root filesystem. Mount points must be absolute, normalized, and distinct; volume data is preserved by any future applicator (never reformatted implicitly).

required.description: If true, boot diagnostics must fail when the volume cannot mount.

fleet.description: Fleet membership metadata for multi-host management; informational only.

secret_references.description: Opaque references to secrets resolved by a future provider at apply time. Inline secret material is forbidden anywhere in the configuration.
